svg.title: Correlation vs Cointegration
svg.desc: Correlation is a property of differences, cointegration of levels. Pairs trading rests on mean reversion of the spread, not on correlation.
svg.text: Correlation vs Cointegration — what pairs trading relies on
Do returns move together, or do levels stay tied?
Input for risk and variance calculations
Long run — reversion of the spread
Unit root test on the residual
Basis for entry and exit rules
Log prices of the two assets
Nothing guarantees z comes back once it leaves
Levels stay tied and the spread reverts
Log prices of the two assets
Enter beyond ±2, exit on the return to 0
Correlation is about same-day direction; cointegration about whether the gap in levels reverts.
Pairs trading rests on mean reversion of the spread, not on correlation.
Correlation is a property of differences,
cointegration is a property of levels
